newsitem.title: USA: Strober to be acquired for $6/shr cash.
newsitem.headline: Strober to be acquired for $6/shr cash.

text.p: The Strober Organization Inc said Monday it has entered into a definitive merger agreement providing for the acquisition of all of Strober's common stock at $6.00 per share, in cash, for an aggregate fully-diluted purchase price of about $32 million.
The merger is expected to be consummated in January 1997, Strober said.
The stock was up 1/8 at 5-3/8 in late morning trading Monday.
The acquisition is led by Fidelity Ventures Limited Partnership, a private venture capital investor, a statement issued by Strober said.
The merger agreement terminates in the event it is not consummated by Feb. 28, 1997 unless an extension is mutually agreed to by the parties to the agreement.
The company said all its management and employees are expected to remain in place after the acquisition.
Strober also said that in light of the pending merger, the company will not proceed with the purchase of Rowley Building Products Corp and Rowley Building Products of New Jersey Inc.
